title: HOW sample_training_data.json BECOMES TRAINING ROWS
description: When you run build_topic_feature_rows(), it aggregates records → topic-level features
step2_process: Group by topic → aggregate learning_scores → count weak students
step3_output: Topic feature rows (4 rows) ready for LogisticRegression model

training_rows._explanation: Model learns: HIGH weak_share (0.75) + LOW avg score (0.42) = WEAK topic (label=1)
Model learns: LOW weak_share (0.0) + HIGH avg score (0.79) = NON-WEAK topic (label=0)

model_learns.positive_class_example: When weak_student_share >= 0.4 AND avg_learning_score < 0.5 → likely WEAK
model_learns.negative_class_example: When weak_student_share == 0.0 AND avg_learning_score > 0.7 → likely NON-WEAK
model_learns.feature_importance: weak_student_share and average_learning_score are the strongest signals

after_training.logistic_regression: Trained on 2 topic examples (1 weak, 1 non-weak)
after_training.prediction_on_new_exam: When new cohort comes, model predicts weak_probability based on 10 features
